note: What both halves of the design-system gate read. The static rules (src/ui-consistency.test.ts) and the rendered sweep (test/contrast.mjs) judge the same lists, so a fifth glass surface or a new screen is taught once instead of twice.
chromeNote: Glass is chrome: the material goes where the page tints through, and content stays opaque. Which of these also blurs is not listed — the sweep derives it from whether anything can be painted behind the surface, and a blur over one flat colour is a finding.
surfacesNote: Every surface the readability sweep must reach. The sweep enumerates Settings sections and detail tabs from the DOM; this is what fails when a surface stops rendering at all.
